## Problem and result / 问题与结果

What triggers the problem, and what changes for the user? Link the issue when relevant.

## Checks actually run / 实际验证

List commands and outcomes; distinguish automated tests from browser checks. Note anything not tested.

## Visual evidence / 视觉证据

For a layout/style/reader change, include a minimal Markdown, preset and before/after evidence.

## Compatibility and assistance / 兼容与辅助

Note preset/recipe compatibility, generated runtime updates, and meaningful AI assistance. Do not claim review that did not happen.
